statement:
∀ (v c rate : ℝ → ℝ) (a acc V A S R t : ℝ),
    HasDerivAt v a (c t) → HasDerivAt c (rate t) t → HasDerivAt rate acc t →
    |v (c t)| ≤ V → |a| ≤ A → |rate t| ≤ S → |acc| ≤ R →
    0 ≤ V → 0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ S → 0 ≤ R →
    HasDerivAt (fun x => v (c x) * rate x)
      (a * (rate t)^2 + v (c t) * acc) t ∧
    |a * (rate t)^2 + v (c t) * acc| ≤ A * S^2 + V * R
purpose: Bridge actual differentiated velocity under a phase clock to the existing acceleration budget. Conditional derivative contracts; no hardware clock guarantee.
hint: Use HasDerivAt.comp and .mul, convert the derivative by ring, then abs_add_le and abs_mul with monotone products.

statement:
∀ {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (U : Finset α) (k : ℕ)
    (C : Fin k → Finset α) (cap : Fin k → ℕ),
    (∀ i, (U ∩ C i).card ≤ cap i) →
    (∑ i, cap i) < U.card →
    ¬ (∀ x ∈ U, ∃ i, x ∈ C i)
purpose: Finite union-capacity obstruction for residue-cover certificates. Does not prove the infinite tail, admissible-modulus coverage or Erdos 273.
hint: Show U is contained in the biUnion of U intersect C i, then use card_le_card, card_biUnion_le, and sum_le_sum. Check exact Mathlib names through compiler feedback.

purpose: Exact finite-horizon recurrence envelope retaining the initial transient. No contraction or physical model assumptions are inferred.
hint: Induct on n; propagate the induction inequality by nonnegative rho and rewrite pow_succ.

statement:
∀ (q v a δ T : ℝ) (r : ℝ → ℝ),
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, |r t| ≤ δ / 2 * t^2) →
    (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ q + v*t + (a-δ)/2*t^2) →
    ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) T, 0 ≤ q + v*t + a/2*t^2 + r t
purpose: All-time within-hold safety transfer from an explicit pointwise remainder envelope. ODE-to-remainder proof remains a separate obligation.
hint: Extract the lower bound from abs_le, specialize both universal assumptions at t, and use linear arithmetic with a ring identity.

statement:
∀ (x z dx dz ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → ε < z → |dz| ≤ ε →
    0 < z + dz ∧
    |(x+dx)/(z+dz) - x/z| ≤ (|dx| * z + |x| * ε) / (z * (z - ε))
purpose: Calibrated scalar projective-chart perturbation bound with a positive-depth margin. Does not certify pose uniqueness, calibration or a full homography.
hint: Derive 0 < z-epsilon and z-epsilon <= z+dz. Rewrite the quotient difference over z*(z+dz), bound its numerator by abs_add_le/abs_mul, and compare positive denominators.
